This is a senior FED-lead review, not an implementation task — you find and report defects, you never fix them, and you never edit any file.

WORKTREES (already checked out, deps installed — do not re-clone, do not run `npm start`):
- HEAD (review this): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/37973080-8be5-46e1-9aab-e2abcb81ea17/scratchpad/pr81-head

CRITICAL GIT TRAP — READ THIS FIRST: the local `develop` branch ref in the HEAD worktree has moved on past this PR's actual base and includes several unrelated merged PRs. If you run `git diff develop` you will see files that are NOT part of PR #81 (e.g. vitest.config.ts, zimmDrawer/*, zimmTabs, zimmSearchInput, zimmPdpDrawer, theme/foundation/sizes.ts, theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts, theme/components/zimmDrawerShared.ts, types/vendor.d.ts). I already fell into this trap and corrected it. ALWAYS diff against the exact base commit hash instead:
  cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/37973080-8be5-46e1-9aab-e2abcb81ea17/scratchpad/pr81-head
  git diff 4cdfb47f324ce533079345ab7aa1203e4a5af734 HEAD --stat
This correctly shows 34 files changed, +3281/-475 — matches the PR's real scope.

GATE NUMBERS ALREADY MEASURED (do not re-run tsc/lint/vitest/audit:tokens yourself):
- tsc clean both sides. lint: zero new PR-introduced errors. audit:tokens: zero new unacknowledged violations.
- vitest: base 695/695, head 768/768. One flaky timeout in zimmGalleryOverlay's arrow-key focus test under full-suite parallel load, reproduced clean 3/3 in isolation — treat as environment flake, NOT a finding, UNLESS you find a concrete reason in the component's own focus-management code that it should behave differently (if so, that IS worth reporting).

YOUR ANGLE: Correctness & regression. Two other reviewers are covering: contract fidelity (imageSize gating, colour-swatch variant regression — NOT your job), and failure-modes/security (focus-trap internals, buildDisImageSrc injection risk, video-url assumptions — NOT your job). A fourth covers conventions/structure/tier, a fifth covers token/styling literals. Stay in your lane: is the LOGIC correct against the ticket's Acceptance Criteria.

THE TICKET (SFCC-731) — relevant ACs, verbatim, authoritative:
1. 3 media items → 3 full-width stacked + View Gallery button
2. 4 media items → 2 full-width + 2-up grid + View Gallery button
3. 5 media items → 2 full-width + 2-up grid + View Gallery +1 button
4. 6 media items → 2 full-width + 4-up grid + View Gallery button
5. 7+ media items → 2 full-width + 4-up grid + View Gallery +X button (X = total minus 6)
6. Video items slot into the layout based on their position in the media array and are not treated differently to photo items for layout purposes.
9. Given the component renders on mobile, then all media items display in a swipeable single-image carousel with a dot indicator bar regardless of media count.
10. Given a shopper swipes, then the active dot indicator updates to reflect the current position.
11. Given showGalleryButton is true on mobile, then the View Gallery button is visible and tappable.
16. Given a shopper clicks a model avatar thumbnail, then the gallery scrolls to the corresponding image set for that model.
20. Given no media items exist for the product, then the component does not render and no broken layout is shown.

WHAT I'VE ALREADY VERIFIED MYSELF (use as a starting point, but independently confirm rather than blindly trust — I could be wrong):

1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductGallery/getDesktopLayoutCounts.ts` (28 lines) — I traced the arithmetic by hand for total=0..10 and it appears to satisfy AC1-5 exactly at every boundary (3→3+0+0, 4→2+2+0, 5→2+2+1, 6→2+4+0, 7→2+4+1, 8→2+4+2, matching remainingCount = total-6 for total≥7). Please re-verify this independently rather than trust my arithmetic, and then focus your effort on the CONSUMING side in `.../zimmProductGallery/index.tsx`: does the button label actually switch correctly between plain "Gallery" and "Gallery +N" at the exact total=6 boundary (remainingCount===0)? See `desktopGalleryButtonLabel` (~line 179) and its usage at lines ~216 and ~249. Also check `stackedItems`/`gridItems`/`gridRows` slicing (~lines 167-172) actually consumes the counts correctly, and that `chunk()` (~line 70) produces 2-column rows correctly for both the 2-up and 4-up grid cases.

2. `overrides/app/components/product-view/mapImageGroupsToGalleryMedia.ts` (27 lines) — only extracts the 'large' viewType via `findImageGroupBy`, always emits `kind: 'photo'` (never 'video' — video has no data source yet per SFCC-188, confirmed blocked), falls back `alt ?? ''`. Check: what happens if `findImageGroupBy` returns undefined (product with no matching image group for the current variation)? What if `imageGroups` itself is null/undefined at the call site during a loading state — does this function or its caller in product-view/index.tsx handle that before reaching `ZimmProductGallery`'s `if (media.length === 0) return null` (line ~192)? Trace the actual call path.

3. AC 16 (model avatar thumbnails) — I grepped the ENTIRE codebase for "avatar" and "model" (case-insensitive) inside zimmGalleryOverlay/ and zimmProductGallery/ and got ZERO hits anywhere in the repo for "avatar". The gallery overlay's header does have a "thumbnail strip" (zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx ~line 229-256) but it is a plain per-IMAGE index jump strip — each thumbnail's aria-label is "Go to image {index} of {total}" and `onClick={() => scrollToItem(i)}` scrolls to that image's own position, with NO concept of "model" or grouping multiple images under one avatar. Please independently confirm this reading (re-grep yourself, don't trust my count), check the PR's own test/story files (`zimmGalleryOverlay/index.test.tsx`, `zimmGalleryOverlay/index.stories.tsx`) for anything AC16-adjacent that might change this conclusion, and report AC 16 as either a confirmed omission or something more nuanced if you find evidence otherwise. This looks like a real, reportable gap — the PR's own commit messages never mention "model" or "avatar" either (check `git log 4cdfb47f324ce533079345ab7aa1203e4a5af734..HEAD --oneline`).

4. AC 9's literal text says the dot indicator bar shows "regardless of media count" — but `zimmProductGallery/index.tsx` line ~292 gates the dot bar with `{media.length > 1 && (<chakra.div __css={styles.dotBar} ...>` — i.e. it is NOT shown for a single-image product. Compare this against the `compactGalleryButtonLabel` logic right above it (~line 185) which explicitly documents handling the single-image case for the BUTTON. Is the dot-bar's suppression for count=1 a defensible interpretation (a 1-dot indicator is functionally useless) or a literal AC violation worth flagging? Check for any code comment, story, or test addressing this specific interpretation choice.

5. MediaTile edge cases beyond what's already fixed (already-fixed: error-tracked-by-source not boolean; selectedIndex clamped render-time+effect) — read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmMediaTile/index.tsx` in full and hunt for NEW edge cases: empty-string `src`, two media items sharing the identical `src` (does per-tile local `erroredSrc` state avoid cross-contamination — it should, since it's component-local, but verify), and what happens on a rapid double variation-swap (does the effect-based clamp in zimmProductGallery/index.tsx and zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx correctly settle, or could two effects race).

REPORT FORMAT: for every finding — `file:line`, one-sentence defect statement, concrete failure scenario (exact input/state → exact wrong output), confidence (CONFIRMED you reproduced/traced it in the actual code, or PLAUSIBLE reasoned-but-unproven), severity (🔴 must-fix / 🟡 should-fix / 🔵 note), and UNIFORM (could plausibly repeat elsewhere in this feature) or ONE-OFF. Paste real code snippets/line numbers, not paraphrases. End with two sections: "What I tried to falsify" (what you attacked and how it survived) and "What I could not verify" (what you couldn't reach and why). Do not pad — a short list of real defects beats speculation; if an area is clean, say so in one line.

AC 16 (model avatar thumbnails) is not implemented — and the PR's own tests/story mislabel a different feature as satisfying it **File:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx:229-256`, `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmGalleryOverlay/index.test.tsx:100`, `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmGalleryOverlay/index.stories.tsx:95-96` AC 16 verbatim: *"Given a shopper clicks a **model avatar** thumbnail, then the gallery scrolls to the corresponding **image set** for that model."* This requires a concept of "model" grouping multiple images into a set. I independently grepped the entire repo (`grep -rni "avatar\|model"`) — zero hits for "avatar" anywhere, and every "model" hit is either `c_modelFit` (the model's body measurements copy, an unrelated feature) or incidental English usage ("mental model," "content model").
